mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_qr_tokens ( token_hash, center_code, center_name, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenHash}, #{centerCode}, #{centerName}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS qr_token_id, center_code, center_name, expires_at FROM attendance_qr_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_qr_verifications ( qr_token_id, member_id, verification_hash, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{qrTokenId}, #{memberId}, #{verificationHash}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS verification_id, v.member_id, t.center_code, t.center_name, v.expires_at AS verification_expires_at FROM attendance_qr_verifications v JOIN attendance_qr_tokens t ON t.id = v.qr_token_id WHERE v.verification_hash = #{verificationHash} AND v.member_id = #{memberId} AND v.consumed_at IS NULL AND v.expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_qr_tokens SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at <= #{now}
